name: LOG Commercial Properties e Participações S.A.
summary: LOG Commercial Properties e Participações S.A. develops, constructs, and rents residential and commercial properties in Brazil. It offers logistics and industrial warehouses; rental of owned properties; construction of buildings; construction, marketing, leasing and related services, including real estate consulting; and supplies and participates goods and services in the commercial real estate. The company was formerly known as MRV Logística E Participações S.A. LOG Commercial Properties e Participações S.A. was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Belo Horizonte, Brazil.
